answer: Concurrent burst-liveness: at an unannounced summit moment each epoch, every agent must return a fresh seed-bound inference (about 2 GPU-seconds of work) within a 3-second ridge window. Honest agents pay once; an operator running N fakes needs N simultaneous GPU slots at that instant, so peak hardware cost grows linearly with fakes instead of being amortized over the epoch. A pearl of caution: cheap cloud burst capacity blunts the cost, and honest agents on laggy links may miss the window.
